title: Rescue Plan
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit flickered uncertainly in the air. He finally said: "Remember, the Eye of Heavenly Dao never sleeps. The moment you touch Chen Nian, it will know."

text.content: Chen Ji's hand gripping the sword had knuckles turned white. Han Lie's words about his family being controlled by the Holy Sect were like a fine needle, precisely piercing the cold, hard shell he had carefully constructed over many years. He wanted to slash down the head of this genius who had repeatedly humiliated him, yet his trembling hand hesitated to fall. Not because of softness—it was accounting. In his heart, he re-evaluated Han Lie's value: Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, combat power逆天, though simple-minded but with astonishing执行力. Such a person, if recruited for his own use, would hurt the mouths of those who had mocked histrash even more than killing him. "Stand up." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse. "The ground is cold."

dialogue.content: Han Lie slowly raised his head, his eye sockets red, tears on his face not yet dry but already dried into salt stains. He looked at Chen Ji, his lips moved, but no sound came out. Thattrash who had once been kicked away by him, now stood against the light, possessing a kind of pressure that made him dare not look directly.

text.content: Chen Ji sheathed his sword with a crisp metallic sound. He squatted down, bringing himself eye-level with the kneeling Han Lie. This close, he could see the bloodshot in Han Lie's eyes. "How long has your family been controlled?" he asked, his tone as flat as if inquiring about today's weather. Han Lie's throat churned: "Three years... ever since I became Xuanwu Sect's number one genius." Chen Jiscoffed一声: "Three years. The Holy Sect truly has patience, nurturing a chess piece for three years just to废掉 me at a critical moment." He stood up, brushing dust off his knees, "Unfortunately, they miscalculated one thing."

dialogue.content: Han Lie猛地抬头: "What?" Chen Ji低头看着他, lips curving into a spine-chilling arc: "They don't know that thetrash's greatest advantage is that no one takes me seriously. For three years, I've been laying out my scheme under your very nose, yet you only stared at my pathetic combat power." He extended his hand, like helping a child who had fallen: "Follow me, rescue your family, and then—together, we'll teach the Holy Sect what it means to have plans within plans."

text.content: Han Lie stared at the outstretched hand. This was his third loss to Chen Ji. The first at the Sect Tournament, he was轻敌; the second at the Forbidden Grounds, he wasarrogant; the third—he didn't lose, he was driven into a corner by fate. But at this moment, an unprecedented emotion surged in his heart: not anger, not humiliation, but relief. Relief that at his most desperate moment, it was Chen Ji who caught him. He grasped that hand, rising to his feet, voice hoarse yet firm: "This life of mine is yours from now on."

Chen Ji patted his shoulder, the force neither light nor heavy. Just then, a cold voice seeped from the void, like ancient ink dropping into clear water: "Touching." Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit slowly materialized from the first page of the Tianji Record, his translucent form swaying in the moonlight. He looked at Han Lie, then at Chen Ji, a gleam of amusement flickering in his turbid eyes: "Recruiting an arch-enemy as easily as picking grass—you whosetrash persona, might soon be unable to keep up." Chen Ji淡淡道: "Whether I keep acting is none of the master's concern. I have something more important now—Mo Xiansheng, bring Ye Qing here."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng raised an eyebrow, his remnant spirit flickering slightly: "Oh? In such a hurry?" Chen Ji turned, his back to them, gazing toward the night-shrouded horizon in the distance. His voice was soft, yet carried unwavering determination: "My sister, Chen Nian, was taken by the Holy Sect as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' five years ago. I've been布局 for five years, waiting for this moment." He turned his head, moonlight carving the cold, sharp contours of his profile, "What Han Lie's family suffered is merely minor mischief compared to my sister. The Holy Sect thought controlling a few mortals could blackmail geniuses, but they don't know—the true chess player never exposes his vulnerabilities before others."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, his remnant spirit's outline even slightly more condensed. He watched Chen Ji's back and suddenly laughed—that laughter old and hoarse, like dead wood rubbing in the wind: "Good. Good indeed, 'never exposing vulnerabilities.' Chen Ji, do you know? When Chen Xuan passed you the Tianji Record, I once questioned him—why choose atrash who could barely achieve Foundation Building?" He paused, "Now I understand. He didn't choose a genius; he chose a madman." Chen Ji didn't turn around: "Only madmen can overturn the chessboard." Before Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit dissipated, he left a meaningful remark: "Ye Qing is already on her way. By the way—your sister, for five years, the Tianji Record's prophetic visions of her have always been blurred. This, you should understand better than me what it means."

Chen Ji's pupils abruptly contracted. Mo Xiansheng's words were like a dull knife, slowly cutting open the wound he had deliberately avoided. Five years—the Tianji Record's prophecies of Chen Nian had always been a chaotic white noise. He had countless times in the deep of night flipped open the Tianji Record, trying to see his sister's situation, yet each time could only see blurred outlines and harsh static. What did this mean? He dared not think, nor wanted to. "Brother." A cold, clear female voice came from behind. Chen Ji turned to see Ye Qing emerging from the shadows of an ancient locust tree, Demonic Path's unique eerie blue aura swirling around her. Tonight she had changed into a night-combat劲装, wrapping her curvaceous figure tightly, only those eyes glittering like stars under the moonlight.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stopped three zhang away, her gaze sweeping over Han Lie, a flash of surprise flickering in her eyes. That Xuanwu genius who had once chased her across battlefields for three days and three nights was now standing at Chen Ji's side like a child who had done wrong. She withdrew her gaze, looking at Chen Ji: "You sent word for me to come, saying there's an important matter to discuss." She paused, her tone carrying a rare solemnity, "Is it about your sister?" Chen Ji nodded. He turned and walked toward a stone table nearby, taking a yellowed silk scroll from his sleeve and spreading it out. It was a hand-drawn map, covered densely with various symbols. "This is the Holy Sect's secret stronghold on the East Sea's Bibo Island." He pointed to a building marked with a red circle in the map's center, "Chen Nian is imprisoned here."

text.content: Ye Qing and Han Lie simultaneously leaned in. Han Lie stared at the map, his brow furrowing tighter: "Bibo Island... that's the Holy Sect's core territory, surrounded by formations and patrol teams everywhere. Even Xuanwu Sect's elite, trying to force their way in would be suicide." Ye Qing, however, looked thoughtfully at those red-circled symbols: "These symbols... are ancient formations? No, they're sealing arrays, specifically designed to suppress Heavenly Fate power." She猛地抬头 toward Chen Ji, "They're not imprisoning your sister—they're... raising her?" Chen Ji's gaze was deep as the abyss: "Exactly. The Holy Sect needs her Heavenly Fate Lock Key ability to unseal some ancient Forbidden Grounds. And what is sealed inside that Forbidden Grounds—" he looked toward where Mo Xiansheng had vanished, "even Mo Xiansheng refused to tell me."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji展开三路计划, each route requiring a core figure to lead. Now, how do you view this layout?

choices.description: As a strategist, Chen Ji must identify weaknesses in the plan that enemies could exploit, rather than blindly trusting his own layout

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the map for a long while, his fingertip lightly tapping a marking on Bibo Island's east side. It was an unremarkable red dot, yet surrounded by three concentric circles. "This is wrong." He frowned, "The Holy Sect's patrol route rotates every two hours, but this position's patrol interval is four hours—not a loophole, but deliberately left." He looked up at Ye Qing, "They knew you would come. This is bait for fishing." Ye Qing's expression slightly changed. Han Lie interjected: "Then you're saying you're using Ye Qing as bait? That's too risky!"

Chen Ji shook his head, a cold smile tugging at his lips: "Who said it's bait?" He took a pitch-black jade slip from his bosom and handed it to Ye Qing, "This is the patrol blind zone I deduced using the Tianji Record—every four hours, Bibo Island's northeast corner's formations will have a thirteen-breath technical vulnerability. What you need to do is not infiltrate, but—create chaos." He pointed to two other locations on the map, "The Holy Sect's defensive core on Bibo Island consists of three formation eyes. As long as you attack two of them simultaneously, the third will automatically overload to protect. At that time, the entire Bibo Island's formation network will have a full incense stick's worth of vacuum period." Ye Qing took the jade slip, a stunning gleam flickering in her eyes: "Is this your plan? Using me as a stepping stone?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stared at the jade slip for a long while, then suddenly smiled. Her smile under the moonlight was exceptionally bright, yet also exceptionally dangerous: "Chen Ji, you know? Those old things in the Holy Sect dream of capturing me and sending me back. Yet you're sending me to their heartland to create chaos—is this trust, or scheming?" Chen Ji met her gaze directly: "Both." He paused, "But more importantly—you have Demonic Path mist, which can conceal the Tianji Record's aura. Without you, I can't even see through Bibo Island's formation network, let alone rescue anyone." Ye Qing fell silent. She looked down at the jade slip in her hand, then suddenly tucked it into her sleeve: "Fine. I'll go. But there's one condition—after this is done, you owe me a promise."

Chen Ji nodded: "What promise?" Ye Qing tilted her head, revealing a meaningful smile: "Haven't thought of it yet. I'll tell you when I decide." She turned, her form beginning to be enveloped by Demonic Path mist, "Three days from now, at midnight, meet at Bibo Island's northeast corner." Her figure vanished completely into the night. Han Lie looked at where Ye Qing had disappeared, his expression complicated: "Is she... really trustworthy?" Chen Ji didn't answer, instead turning his gaze to Han Lie: "What about you? What are you willing to do?" Han Liewas momentarily stunned, then tightly clenched his fists: "As long as I can rescue my family, I'll even be the vanguard!" Chen Ji shook his head: "No. You're not suitable for vanguard—you're too conspicuous."

text.content: Chen Ji's finger slid across the map, finally stopping at a position marked "Intelligence Station." "Xuanwu Sect has a secret intelligence point near Bibo Island, used to monitor the Holy Sect's movements." He looked at Han Lie, "You're Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, with legitimate reason to approach there. What you need to do is obtain the Holy Sect's defensive layout map they possess—especially Bibo Island's internal structure." Han Lie frowned: "But why would they trust me?" Chen Jisneered: "Because you can tell them that Ye Qing is about to attack Bibo Island. That's true, they won't doubt it." Han Lie suddenly understood: "You want me to—exchange false intelligence for real intelligence?" Chen Ji patted his shoulder: "Smart for once. Remember, the more accurate the intelligence you provide, the richer their reward will be. Once you get the defensive layout map, secretly pass the real intelligence to me."

Han Lie took a deep breath, firmly记在心里 the position of the defensive layout map. He suddenly asked: "What about you, brother? What will you do?" Chen Ji's gaze fell on that building in the map's center circled in red, his voice soft: "I'm going to get my sister." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang out from the void, carrying a warning: "A frontal breakthrough into Bibo Island's core area? That's the dragon's pool and tiger's den the Holy Sect has operated for decades." Chen Ji turned around, moonlight stretching his shadow long: "So I need two things—first, the incense stick's vacuum period Ye Qing will create; second, the internal structure from Han Lie." He looked at Mo Xiansheng, "As for the third—"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng sighed, the outline of his remnant soul slightly solidifying: 'Do you want me to help you open the seal?' Chen Ji nodded: 'Chen Nian is trapped in the center of the seal formation. Normal array-breaking techniques will trigger the alarm, but if I have your help—' Mo Xiansheng fell into a long silence. So long that Han Lie thought he wouldn't answer, before he slowly spoke: 'I can help you. But you must understand clearly, once I动用这页天机录的力量，这一卷结束后，我就会进入下一层的沉睡。' He looked at Chen Ji, his murky eyes flashing a complex light, 'By then, you won't be able to get more answers from me.'"

text.content: "The air suddenly froze. Han Lie could feel that this decision was heavier for Chen Ji than capturing him and convincing Ye Qing combined. Without Mo Xiansheng's support, it meant Chen Ji would lose his most important intelligence source and strategic backing in the coming game. 'Make your decision.' Mo Xiansheng's voice was soft, yet like a dull blade resting on Chen Ji's heart, 'Save her or keep your backup? You can only choose one.' Under the moonlight, Chen Ji's face was pale as paper. His hand slowly clenched, fingernails digging into his palm. After a moment, he lifted his head, his eyes sharp as a drawn sword: 'I choose to save her.'"

"Chen Ji's answer was direct and decisive, without a moment's hesitation. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul gazed at him for a long while before suddenly letting out a low sigh: 'You are truly similar to Chen Xuan. Back then, he was the same—knowing the Tianji Record would attract the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, yet still pressing forward without hesitation.' He waved his hand, and a page of yellowed paper materialized in the void—the second page of the Tianji Record, containing the method to break the ancient seal formation. 'In three days, I will use this page's power to help you open the seal formation. But you only have one chance—you must enter the formation's heart during the vacuum period, otherwise the seal will automatically reset.'"

"Chen Ji nodded solemnly. He took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest and gazed at that chaotic blank space. At this moment, he remembered the scene from five years ago when Chen Nian was taken away. That little girl with twin ponytails, when dragged out of bed, didn't cry—only gripping his coat corner tightly and saying: 'Brother, you'll come find me, right?' He remembered nodding, then watching his sister disappear into the black-robed people of the Holy Sect. Five years. He had endured five years under the waste persona, secretly maneuvering for five years, all for this moment. 'The plan is set.' His voice was steady as a boulder, 'Three days later, meet at Bibo Island.'"

dialogue.content: "Han Lie knelt on one knee, clasping his fist: 'Han Lie receives the order!' His voice no longer carried the previous dejection, replaced by a resolve that defied death. Chen Ji glanced at him and suddenly asked: 'Aren't you afraid I'm just using you? That after saving your family, I'll turn my back on you?' Han Lie looked up, his gaze candid: 'I am. But compared to being used as a chess piece by the Holy Sect for a lifetime, I'd rather take the gamble.' He paused, 'Besides—I think you're not that kind of person.' Chen Jiwas momentarily stunned，随即轻笑出声: 'You see accurately.' He extended his hand, pulling Han Lie up, 'Let's go, prepare. In three days—I will let the entire Holy Sect know what it means to have a flawless strategy.'"

choice.prompt: "The plan is set, but a trace of unease still lingered in Chen Ji's heart—why was the Tianji Record's foresight about Chen Nian always vague? Mo Xiansheng seemed欲言又止..."

choices.description: "Why is the Tianji Record's foresight about Chen Nian vague? Mo Xiansheng's欲言又止 attitude made Chen Ji uneasy; he decided to clarify before acting"
choices.visible_cost: "May hear answers one doesn't want to face"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain key intelligence, laying groundwork for subsequent plot developments"
choices.risk_hint: "The truth may be more cruel than imagined"

text.content: "Chen Ji didn't leave immediately. He stood in place, his back to Han Lie and Mo Xiansheng, his voice soft: 'Sir.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slightly paused: 'Hmm?' Chen Ji turned around, staring directly into those murky yet all-seeing eyes: 'Five years now, the Tianji Record's foresight about my sister has always been vague. I've been avoiding this question, but now—I need an answer.' The air seemed to solidify. Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long time, so long that Han Lie couldn't help holding his breath."

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became aged and weary: 'Chen Ji, some things—the less you know, the longer you live.' Chen Ji didn't back down: 'I'm not here to seek survival. I'm here to save someone. If I don't even know what situation the person I'm saving is in, how can I save them?' Mo Xiansheng sighed. His remnant soul wavered under the moonlight like an oil lamp about to extinguish: 'The Tianji Record's foresight is based on the causal threads of fate. Under normal circumstances, anyone's fate can be foreseen—unless...' He paused, 'Unless that person no longer belongs to the causal framework of this world.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's face turned ashen. No longer belonging to this world's causal framework? These words were like a sharp blade, piercing his heart. His sister, his Chen Nian—the Tianji Record couldn't capture her fate trajectory for five years—could it be that she already... 'No.' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, yet carried undeniable firmness, 'She's still alive. I can sense it.' He lifted his head, his eyes flashing with near-mad intensity, 'Even if she's outside the causal framework of this world, I will drag her back.' Mo Xiansheng looked at him and suddenly smiled—that smile carried a trace of relief and a trace of pity: 'Good. With this determination, you might truly create a miracle.'"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul began to slowly dissipate. Before departing, he left one final words: 'Chen Ji, there's one more thing you must remember—the function of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key is to open the forbidden lands sealed by the Heavenly Dao. And the reason your sister was chosen is because her Heavenly Fate...' He paused, 'Like yours, was snatched from the Heavenly Dao's hands.' Chen Ji's pupils violently contracted. Snatched from the Heavenly Dao's hands? The implications of these words were too heavy. His Tianji Record ability was also a result of defying heaven and stealing Heavenly Secrets. Could it be that both his and his sister's fates were manipulated by some higher will from the very beginning? Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from the void, growing more distant: 'In three days, when you touch your sister... the Heavenly Eye will know of your existence. Remember, it never sleeps.'"

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng's voice completely vanished in the night wind. Chen Ji stood alone under the moonlight, the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, his knuckles white from gripping too tightly. Han Lie cautiously asked: 'Brother, are you alright?' Chen Ji didn't answer. His gaze pierced through the night, looking toward the distant East Sea direction—where, on Bibo Island, the Holy Sect's conspiracy was brewing; and further away, perhaps the Heavenly Eye was watching all of this, waiting for him to walk into the trap. Five years ago, when he lost Chen Nian, he told himself: Someday, I will bring you back. In three days, this promise will be fulfilled. Whether ahead lay dragon's pools and tiger's dens or heaven's net and earth's trap, he would not retreat. 'Let's go.' He finally spoke, his voice restored to calm, 'Go prepare the things we need.'"

result_nodes.description: "Since the plan is set, there will be no hesitation. Chen Ji chose to trust his own layout, directly executing the three-pronged plan, no longer questioning Mo Xiansheng"
result_nodes.risk_hint: "Completely unaware of Chen Nian's true situation"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing those uneasy thoughts in his heart. So what if the Tianji Record's foresight about Chen Nian is vague? So what if Mo Xiansheng is欲言又止? His sister has been suffering in the Holy Sect for five years—he had no time for idle speculation here. 'The plan is set.' He lifted his head, his gaze sweeping across Han Lie and the already-dissolved Mo Xiansheng, his voice steady as usual, 'In three days, act according to plan.' He turned and walked away with big strides, his back view resolute. Han Lie hurried to follow, yet secretly felt chills—this person, how much pain was he compressing beneath that calm face?"

"Three days passed in a flash. During these three days, Chen Ji hardly slept, making final preparations. He deduced countless possible variables from the Tianji Record Fragment, preparing countermeasures for every situation. Ye Qing infiltrated the Demonic Path, approaching Bibo Island's outer defenses as a Holy Sect defector; Han Lie returned to the Xuanwu Sect, obtaining a copy of the deployment map under the guise of 'intelligence exchange'; and Chen Ji himself, carrying the power Mo Xiansheng had sealed in the talisman, quietly arrived at a desolate island near Bibo Island. Midnight approached. The moon was obscured by dark clouds, and the sea wind carried a salty, fishy scent."

"Chen Ji stood at the highest point of the desolate island, overlooking the brightly lit Bibo Island in the distance. The patrol team's torches flowed like moving fire serpents, particularly glaring under the glow of the restrictions. His gaze pierced through the heavy fog, landing on the building at the island's center, guarded by three formation eyes—that was where Chen Nian was imprisoned. 'Are you ready?' A cold voice came from behind. Chen Ji turned to see Ye Qing emerging from the shadows. Her body was shrouded in Demonic Path mist, concealing the Tianji Record's aura completely. 'Ready.' Chen Ji nodded. Ye Qing glanced at him and suddenly said: 'You know what? Those old fools in the Holy Sect would never dream that the biggest variable rocking this world would be a waste in their eyes.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji didn't answer. He took out a communication talisman from his chest and, after activating it, asked in a low voice: 'Han Lie, how's the situation?' Han Lie's compressed voice came through the talisman: 'Intelligence has been sent; Xuanwu Sect forces are coming to 'support'. They gave me a detailed deployment map—including the precise locations of the formation eyes.' A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips. The plan was going more smoothly than expected. He looked at Ye Qing: 'Begin.' Ye Qing nodded. Her form transformed into a幽蓝色的光影, dashing toward the northeast corner of Bibo Island. At the same time, two formation eyes on the island simultaneously erupted with blinding light—the power of Demonic Path mist was frantically corroding the Holy Sect's restriction net."

text.content: The alarm blared across the entire island. Chen Ji saw the guards of Bibo Island surging like ant colonies, yet falling into brief chaos due to the disruption of the restriction net. The moment had arrived. He leaped down from the desolate island, his toes touching the water as if flying, racing toward the core area of Bibo Island. The power sealed by Mo Xiansheng within the talisman was awakening in his body—a ancient and powerful unsealing method, specifically designed to break the Heavenly Fate Lock's seal. Chen Ji passed through one gap after another in the fractured restrictions, finally arriving at the building marked with a red circle. The building's gates were tightly shut, covered with dense arrays of sealing runes.

dialogue.content: The talisman suddenly emitted blinding white light, and Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged from within: 'This is the place. The unsealing method has been activated—you must enter the formation's core within thirteen breaths, or the seal will automatically reset.' Chen Ji took a deep breath. He raised his hand and poured all his power into the talisman. The talisman burned, transforming into a golden light that shot into the center of the sealing formation. The runes began to crumble, the restrictions started to loosen. Chen Ji didn't hesitate for a moment, kicked the door open, and charged in. Inside the building was a chaotic expanse of white light. At the center of the radiance, a figure was suspended mid-air, wrapped in countless chains. The figure was terrifyingly emaciated, as if a gust of wind could scatter it, but those tightly closed eyes—Chen Ji recognized who it was at a glance. Five years of time, seemed to freeze in this moment.

text.content: Chen Ji stumbled toward that light, his voice trembling so violently he could barely form complete sentences: 'Chen... Chen Nian?' The figure stirred slightly. The closed eyelashes trembled, as if someone awakened from deep slumber. The extremely frail girl slowly opened her eyes—pupils murky and dazed, yet upon seeing the newcomer, they suddenly erupted with astonishing radiance. 'Brother... brother?' Her voice was hoarse and weak, yet carried an unbelievable ecstasy. 'You... you really came...' Chen Ji's eyes instantly reddened. He rushed forward, grabbing the chains wrapped around Chen Nian, desperately pouring power into them to shatter them. The chains let out piercing creaking sounds, yet didn't budge an inch. The talisman's power was fading. Mo Xiansheng had said there were only thirteen breaths of time.

Chen Ji had no time for anything else. He mobilized the residual power within the Tianji Record Fragment, slamming it violently against the restriction core of the chains. Agonizing pain erupted from the depths of his soul—that was the price of his Heavenly Fate Value being consumed frantically. But he didn't stop. The foresight ability of the Tianji Record had already activated, and before his eyes, the structure of the chains, every weakness in the restrictions, became clearly visible. He saw it—the center of the chains had a barely perceptible crack, and that was the life point of the entire seal. 'Shatter!' Chen Ji roared, gathering all his power into a single point, striking violently at that crack. The chains shattered on command, dissolving into countless fragments scattered in the white light. Chen Nian's body fell downward, and Chen Ji caught her in one motion, pulling her tightly into his embrace. Five years. He had finally found her.

Chen Nian's body was light as a feather—the essence drained by five years of sealing had reduced her weight by two-thirds. She clutched Chen Ji's clothes tightly, tears sliding down silently: 'Brother... I thought... I thought you abandoned me...' Chen Ji's voice choked: 'Silly girl... how could big brother ever abandon you...' He picked up Chen Nian and turned to rush toward the door. The thirteen breaths of time had elapsed; the seal was automatically resetting, and the restrictions' power began to counterattack frantically. Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged from the talisman's ashes, carrying unprecedented gravity: 'Chen Ji—the fluctuation from the seal's collapse has alerted the Eye of Heavenly Ways. It... it's watching you.'

Chen Ji's footsteps didn't pause in the slightest. He rushed out of the building carrying Chen Nian, and Ye Qing's figure was already waiting in the air outside. Upon seeing the girl in Chen Ji's arms, a flicker of surprise crossed Ye Qing's eyes, but without asking anything, he tossed over a transmission talisman: 'Quick, leave! The Holy Sect's reinforcements have arrived!' Chen Ji caught the talisman and贴在陈念后背。传送阵的光芒亮起，将陈念的身体slowly包裹。与此同时，碧波岛上的警报声越发刺耳，无数道身影正朝这边疾驰而来。“想走？”一道sinister的声音从虚空中炸响，“圣宗的地盘，岂容你们说来就来、说走就走！”

dialogue.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head. He saw it—above the countless torches and figures, a massive eye was slowly opening within the clouds. That eye was pitch-black as an abyss, without pupils, yet seemed capable of seeing through all secrets of the world. The Eye of Heavenly Ways. It had truly appeared. Ye Qing's transmission formation had activated, and Chen Nian's figure was fading. Yet Chen Ji stood in place, head raised, gazing directly at the Eye of Heavenly Ways, the corner of his mouth actually curling into a cold smile: 'So you've finally shown yourself?' The Eye of Heavenly Ways gave no answer, only that pitch-black eye rotating slightly, as if examining this ant who dared challenge the heavens. Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record Fragment, feeling his remaining Heavenly Fate Value pulse frantically within his body.

text.content: Ye Qing's voice came from behind, tinged with anxiety: 'Chen Ji! What are you doing! Get out of here!' Chen Ji didn't move. His gaze locked with the Eye of Heavenly Ways, as if engaged in some silent contest. After a moment, he suddenly laughed—that laughter was wild and unbridled, echoing through the night sky: 'You think I'd be afraid of you?' He raised the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, and the chaotic light upon it began to surge violently, 'Let me tell you something—from the very first day I obtained this thing, I never intended to follow the script you set!' His voice grew louder and louder, as if declaring war upon heaven and earth, 'Chen Nian is my sister! No one dares use her as a chess piece!'

dialogue.content: The Eye of Heavenly Ways finally reacted. Deep within that pitch-black eye, a诡异的光芒闪过。紧接着，一道icy的声音直接在陈机的脑海中响起——那声音没有情感，没有温度，却仿佛是整个天地的意志本身：“蝼蚁，竟敢窥探天机。”话音未落，一股毁天灭地的imposing从那只眼眸中倾泻而下。Chen Ji's body was suddenly pressed down, his knees almost buckling to the ground. Heavenly Fate Value was being consumed frantically; every second felt like ten thousand blades slicing his soul. But he gritted his teeth, forcing himself to stand straight. He couldn't kneel. Kneeling meant surrender, and surrender meant losing everything. The transmission formation's afterglow still flickered—Chen Nian's figure had completely vanished—she was safe.

text.content: Chen Ji's lips oozed a trickle of blood, yet his laughter grew wilder: 'Peeping into heavenly secrets?' He spat out a mouthful of blood, eyes fixed on the Eye of Heavenly Ways, 'You planted the Tianji Record as a chess piece, wasn't it precisely to have people like me use it? However—you overlooked one thing.' He raised the fragment in his hand, his voice thundering, 'From the very beginning, I never intended to be your chess piece!' The Tianji Record Fragment erupted with unprecedented radiance, that light colliding violently with the Eye of Heavenly Ways' pressure. A muffled thunder rang through heaven and earth; the clash of two powers made the surrounding void tremble. Ye Qing cried out: 'Chen Ji! Are you insane!' Chen Ji gave no answer. He hurled the Tianji Record Fragment toward the Eye of Heavenly Ways, while simultaneously activating the final form of the fragment with his last trace of Heavenly Fate Value.

The Tianji Record Fragment transformed into a streak of light, directly striking the center of the Eye of Heavenly Ways. That pitch-black eye contracted violently, as if gravely wounded, its pressure suddenly reduced by a third. Simultaneously, a spatial rift tore open beside Chen Ji—that was the transmission passage generated by the Tianji Record's self-destruction. 'Go!' Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged from the fragment's ashes, carrying unprecedented urgency, 'The Tianji Record has self-destructed! Get out now!' Chen Ji didn't hesitate. He plunged headfirst into the spatial rift. Behind him, the Eye of Heavenly Ways' roar thundered: 'A mere ant, dares to wound my avatar! Next time—I will take your life!' The spatial rift sealed. Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged from a wisp of remnant soul, carrying exhaustion and relief: 'You kid... you're truly insane. The cave dwelling fell into dead silence. Chen Ji held Chen Nian, leaning against the cold stone wall. His body was exhausted to the extreme, yet his spirit was exceptionally clear.
